rows.grounds: qualified agent of the prescribed acts

items.question: Who is qualified to carry out the previously prescribed ritual acts?
premises: The preceding verses prescribe specific ritual acts.
The verb kuryāt enjoins performance of those acts.
The agent is designated as vicakṣaṇaḥ, a discerning person.
items.inference: Therefore, the discerning person is the one who should perform the prescribed ritual acts.
uncertainties: The exact scope of acts included from the preceding verses is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: The discerning person should perform these acts.
